---
title: "MGLTools 1.5.6"
---

MGLTools 1.5.6 is an open-source software suite comprising:

- **PMV**, the Python Molecular Viewer
- **ADT**, a graphical front end for AutoDock
- **Vision**, a visual programming environment

[Download MGLTools 1.5.6](../download.qmd#version-1.5.6)

## Tutorials

- [PMV tutorial](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/mgltools-tutorials/PmvTut1page-1.pdf) (PDF of PowerPoint slides, 47 MB)
- [Vision tutorial](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/mgltools-tutorials/VisionTut1Page.pdf) (PDF of PowerPoint slides, 15.8 MB)
